Class Countdown Implements Iterable
    Property Start As Integer

    Constructor(start As Integer)
        Me.Start = start
    End Constructor

    Function GetIterator() As CountdownIterator
        Return New CountdownIterator(Me.Start)
    End Function
End Class



For Each n As Integer In New Countdown(3)
    Print(n)
Next
# Prints: 3, 2, 1, 0
